advisory: ReDoS / infinite loop in image-size bitmap header parsing
reason: Pinned transitively by pptxgenjs@4.0.1 via its own dependency range; no upstream release of pptxgenjs yet declares a fixed image-size. Upstream block, not fixable from this repo.
exploitability: The vulnerable path parses attacker-supplied image bytes. In Metis Diagram, image bytes come from the local user's own files and from figures rendered by our own pipeline — never from untrusted network input. No remote attacker surface is exposed by default.
mitigation: Files processed are local, user-authored decks; renderer extracts images only after our own type sniffing. Gorden template imports (untrusted PPTX) are parsed by our own analyzer which does not invoke image-size. Advised upgrade path tracked: bump pptxgenjs when upstream lands the fixed image-size range.
